comparison.objective: Remove a tagged bin from the middle of a gravity lane while restraining the following bin, then close the lane.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-back and extraction under gravity, followed by controlled release and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Tagged bin rests in reject tote; next bin moves at most 2 cm before placement; remaining bins close against the stop without falls or tipping.
comparison.reason: This tests transient gravity-flow control and material handling, not mechanism adjustment or dynamic damping calibration.
